name: Pirate's Booty Aged White Cheddar Baked Rice & Corn Puffs
whyItWorks: Baked from milled rice and corn flour without any hard hulls or kernels. The airy puffs melt in the mouth, delivering savory white cheddar flavor with zero abrasive fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat straight from the bag. A beloved staple for sensitive stomachs and school lunches.
watchOuts: Contains real cheese; virtually lactose-free in standard single-serving bags.
